summary: Restore complete failed patches and report rollback conflicts honestly

delivery.outcome: Undo the exact applied diff on failed direct verification, including file additions/deletions, while preserving index and unrelated edits. Report rollback conflict or verifier exception honestly, never claiming an untouched workspace when recovery failed.
nonGoals: Change commit-failure rollback or worktree allocation/promotion
Resolve protected controller admission or deploy/restart production lanes
Guarantee rollback of arbitrary verifier side effects outside patch targets

architecture.decision: Reverse the exact patch with git apply --reverse --check followed by atomic apply. Refuse reversal when concurrent edits make it unsafe. Reuse terminal refused journal phase with an explicit rollback-failed code; preserve existing success code and function signature. Catch verifier exceptions as failed verification so restoration still runs.
interfaceChanges: Add stable verify_failed_rollback_failed outcome code to the existing queue result API
architecture.rollback: Revert material commit; keep failing-run evidence and service stopped.

validation.evidence: Real Git: mixed additions/modifications/deletions reversed; unrelated staged/unstaged data preserved; conflicting edits survive with non-retryable failure and truthful journal; verifier exception also rolls back.
Scoped Ruff and managed governance, protected CI and independent review.
